safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  name.char_count() > 0 and name.split("..").len() == 1 and name.split("/").get(0) != "" and name.split("\\").len() == 1

first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post names.len() > 0 or out == ""
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret", "/etc/passwd"]) == ""
  var found: str? = None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if found == None and safe_name(name)
        found = fs.read(name) else None
  found else ""
